cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Sell the Disaster
cards.instruction: Make a terrible plan sound sensible, responsible, and inevitable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Removing the restaurant roof is our only affordable way to fix the ventilation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. We close. A responsible business protects its customers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Rain is forecast all opening week.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll save a week's wages. Put that toward umbrellas; we can't afford to abandon the savings now.

mechanism: A sells roof removal as prudent ventilation by correcting B risk calculations and treating increasingly absurd closure costs as professional planning.
confusable: Ordinary optimism celebrates outcomes; this A must persuade B the bad plan is financially responsible and necessary.
comparison: Auction alternative compounds borrowing obligations; roof scene reframes weather exposure as disciplined operating policy.
seedUse: Roof removal, rain and wages derive from D17-a; S03 adds precise corrections to what counts as an operating loss.
